name: input_useinteresting
about: UseInteresting switches the interesting-place programs on. CAI_BaseNPCTroika::InputUseInteresting 0x102c2a70 writes the byte m_bUseInteresting +0x63d9 and nothing else; when the running program ends, SelectSchedule case 1 step 4 (0x102af6eb) answers 0xff SCHED_TROIKA_WALK_TO_INTERESTING_PLACE_SETUP. Param verbatim from hw_netcafe_1 (BobInTheRafters '1'). sm_hub_1's bum_female (npc_VPedestrian, use_interesting 0, groups '4 31') verbatim; the arena's anchors are group 1, which her groups do not list, so the record stands one intersting_place of group 4 beside her.
known_red: V3b: 6: the port's ambient executor answers use_interesting instead of the 0xff program
notes: w_bum_spot carries sm_hub_1's bum_huddle keys (group_id 4) verbatim, so the switched-on pedestrian has a place in reach; the arena's own anchors are group 1.
